source.text:
name: Isolated Gemini A/B (manual only)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirm_two_billable_requests:
        description: 'Type YES to authorize 2 billable Gemini requests with synthetic data'
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  isolated-ab:
    if: ${{ github.event.inputs.confirm_two_billable_requests == 'YES' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pinned experiment commit (not Production)
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 9d7b14d42e279d249f48482209b6d130f36674d9
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/context-ab-*.test.ts
      - name: Run exactly two synthetic Gemini requests
        env:
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MISAKI_AB_GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          MISAKI_AB_LIVE: 'YES'
          MISAKI_AB_MODEL: gemini-3.1-flash-lite
          MISAKI_AB_RUNS: '1'
        run: |
          if [ -z "$GEMINI_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo 'Secret missing; refusing live calls.'
            exit 1
          fi
          node --experimental-strip-types scripts/context-ab-live.ts
